question: Why is the supreme Lord not tainted by time and limitation?
premises: For nondualists, the universe is made of the knower and the knower is made of the universe.
This reciprocal identity leaves no external limiting principle over the Lord.
Therefore the nets and mires of time and limitation do not taint the supreme Lord.
inference: Because knower and universe are non-different, the supreme Lord remains untouched by time and limitation.
plain_english: For those for whom the universe is made of the knower and the knower is likewise made of the universe, the supreme Lord is not tainted by the nets and mires of time and limitation.
